note: 06:00 and 07:00 are the daily today-board sweeps (food, then FDE): they collect during minutes 0-28 and minute 30 only finalizes. 09/12/20 (food) and 10/13/21 (FDE) collect during minutes 0-18, minute 20 only finalizes, and minutes 22-30 exit immediately. The two tracks never share an hour, so a wake-up always belongs to exactly one of them.
